observations: Retained original archive and six real HTML/security tests checked before writes.
Only exact three old or new file identities are admitted; unknown content is never overwritten.
Owner service is stopped around source replacement; update service stays live and its PID is checked.
Same-filesystem atomic replacement preserves ownership and permissions; journal and original bytes support rollback.
Rollback of owner source does not depend on a healthy proxy or update service.
Public callback uses an error branch before database work; login transactions are not manufactured.
Deployment will be dispatched sequentially after APK45 publication, not concurrently with a publisher.
